proposal.name: Keep late answers from delivering statues twice

issue_plan.name: Keep late answers from delivering statues twice
issue_plan.summary: One plumbing issue fixes statue recovery by remembering every task delivered or cleared on this page, plus the dismissed task read when the page loads, and checking that memory when a latest-task answer arrives. It keeps the existing service functions, single stored task ID, delivery retries, names, polling, Clear behavior and messages. Acceptance tests cover an old answer arriving after another statue has been delivered, while preserving the existing tests. After the fix merges, bring pull request #31 up to date with main and rerun its unchanged gate.

issues.title: Prevent late recovery answers from delivering dismissed statues again
issues.body:
Fix hooks/use-statue-task.ts so a delayed latest-task answer cannot recover a task this page has already delivered or cleared, or the task stored as dismissed when the page loaded. Issue #27's ratified at-most-once delivery rule failed in draft pull request #31's delayed-latest-across-receipts scenario: recovery delivers task 1, another recovery request waits, task 2 starts and finishes, and the old answer then names task 1. The current comparison sees only task 2 in storage and delivers task 1 again. Issue #29's single stored ID remains sufficient across reloads, but cannot remember all tasks excluded from recovery during one page's lifetime.

Keep a collection of excluded task IDs in the hook that survives rerenders and effect reruns for that page. Seed it with getDismissedStatueTaskId() when the hook initializes, before any latest-task answer can arrive. Add a fresh or recovered task only after onDeliver resolves successfully, and add the last adopted task immediately when dismiss() clears it. Remember all these IDs until the page is reloaded; later completions or clears must not replace earlier entries. Check this current collection after awaiting fetchLatestStatueTask(), before adopting its answer, alongside the existing cancellation, running-task, stored-dismissal and eligibility checks. The page's memory must work even if localStorage reads or writes fail. Keep pending or rejected deliveries recoverable unless explicitly cleared, and let delivery already under way finish after Clear.

Leave lib/statue.ts, its exported functions and its storage unchanged, including the ask3d:dismissed-statue-task key holding just one ID. Continue calling setDismissedStatueTaskId() at the existing successful-delivery and Clear points; do not persist the page's collection. Across reloads, unavailable storage still means best-effort recovery. Preserve the public hook interface, starting and health checks, the one-task guard through delivery, four-second waits before polling, stopping at the fifth consecutive poll failure and resetting that count after a response, recovery of queued/running tasks or succeeded tasks younger than 600 seconds, delivery metadata, and every progress and error message. Preserve photo-basename-statue-full-task-id.stl and recovered-statue-full-task-id.stl naming, stripping only the photo's final extension and retaining the name on same-page retries.

Add acceptance coverage in lib/__tests__/statue-recovery.accept.test.ts, following the existing hook tests' public-interface host, mocked lib/statue.ts functions, deferred promises and fake timers. Keep all existing tests and assertions in lib/__tests__/statue-task.accept.test.ts and lib/__tests__/statue-delivery.accept.test.ts.

Acceptance must demonstrate:

- Recover and successfully deliver task 1; rerun the recovery effect and hold its latest-task answer pending; start and successfully deliver a different task 2 so the stored ID becomes task 2 and the guard is released; then resolve the still-live pending answer with eligible task 1. Advance timers beyond the polling interval and assert exactly one delivery per task, the expected recovered and source-based names, no further polling or model download for task 1, idle progress, and storage still naming task 2. This test must fail on the original hook and pass with the fix; effect cleanup or a busy guard must not be what rejects the answer.
- A task stored as dismissed before mounting remains excluded when a pending answer names it after a newer delivery has replaced the stored ID, even though the old task was never delivered on this page.
- A task cleared on this page remains excluded after a different task replaces the stored ID, including when the cleared task's delivery did not succeed. Same-page exclusions for successfully delivered and cleared tasks also hold with unavailable storage. Existing retry tests must continue to show that an uncleared rejected delivery can recover, and existing Clear tests must continue to allow in-flight delivery to finish.

Update README.md's statue recovery description to explain page-lifetime memory and the unchanged single-ID, best-effort persistence across reloads. Run the new regression coverage and the existing test suite, lint and typecheck. This is one plumbing fix with acceptance tests under D-0105. After it merges, bring draft pull request #31 up to date with main and rerun its existing gate against the fixed hook without changing its check or driver scenarios; that follow-up uses the existing #27/#31 verification work.

Kind: plumbing
